value.bindings: X=ℝⁿ,Y=J,s=C*,t=J (product of the compact support set and time interval).
hypothesis_checks: ℝⁿ and J are topological spaces.
C* is compact as a finite union of compact sets.
J is compact as a closed bounded interval.

value.bindings: α=ℝⁿ, μ=Lebesgue, 𝕜=E=ℝ, x₀=r, s=(r/2,3r/2), F(τ)(x)=e(x,τ), F′(τ)(x)=e_t(x,τ), bound=b.
hypothesis_checks: F(τ) is strongly measurable by continuity for every τ near r.
F′(r) is strongly measurable by continuity.
F′ is bounded by b for all x and τ in the interval, as proved in S001.
b is integrable by M008 and M009.
Smoothness gives the pointwise derivative of F equal to F′ for every x and τ.
C* is measurable and has finite Lebesgue measure by N001.
K is a finite real number, hence has finite extended norm.
The constant function K is integrable on C* by M008.

value.bindings: β=ℝⁿ×J, α=ℝ with usual order topology, K=C*×J, f(x,τ)=|e_t(x,τ)|.
hypothesis_checks: ℝ is linearly ordered with usual topology and closed upper rays.
